title: IT Help Desk Inspection Checklist
subtitle: IT Help-Desk Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: IT Help Desk Inspection Checklist covers user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function. The service desk coordinator records IT Help-Desk Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. IT Help Desk Inspection Checklist keeps IT Help-Desk Service exceptions visible until the service desk coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use IT Help Desk Inspection Checklist at approved remote session, user workspace, equipment room, or service environment. Document user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function identity before IT Help-Desk Service begins. Compare user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function findings with stated IT Help-Desk Service criteria; route unresolved IT Help-Desk Service issues to authorized IT support reviewer. For IT Help Desk Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for IT Help-Desk Service. Ask authorized IT support reviewer to review IT Help-Desk Service conditions beyond the service desk coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For IT Help-Desk Service, identify responsible parties, approved remote session, user workspace, equipment room, or service environment, and the linked user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function source.

fields.label: Device, asset tag, hostname, account, or service identifier
Affected application, location, and business-impact reference

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture IT Help-Desk Service facts for user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: IT Help-Desk Service inspection checks
items: Error text, timestamp, log, and recent-change history
Device, operating system, application, and network context
Post-change functional and user acceptance result

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved IT Help-Desk Service finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Service Desk Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Change exceeds approved access or maintenance window
Security incident indicators require separate response
Test result without unnecessary sensitive data
blocks.guidance: Pause IT Help-Desk Service when identity, authorization, security, backup, or rollback control is unresolved. Retain the available IT Help-Desk Service proof and route unresolved user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function scope to service desk coordinator.
